units.name: Take a question
units.purpose: Pick the next ready, unconsumed question (preferring an unused gap, then unused axes) and copy it into a new generation folder with its section-9 handover.
units.necessity: Makes ideas differ by construction: each generation takes a different question instead of looking at other generations.
units.trigger: GATE-recon-check passed and generations remain (LOOP-12), or the previous generation was abandoned (LOOP-11).
units.legacy_deviation: No legacy registry card; implemented by ideate_tools.py question-next / question-take (tests/planning/test_p0_handover.py). Legacy P1 requires B3.5 and F.9 directly.
preconditions: the question is ready (or screen_unresolved when nothing ready remains) and not consumed
logic: question-next: ready and unconsumed; prefer a gap no idea used, then axes no idea used; fall back to screen_unresolved
question-take: refuse a consumed question or an occupied generation
write gen_k/question.json (question, gap, move, collisions, section 9) and gen_k/step7b_problem.md
units.state: Per generation; the topic's question file is never edited by planning (B5 revises the generation's copy).

error_boundary.local_recovery: no ready question -> write questions for the next ranked gaps (back to B3.5)
error_boundary.escalation: nothing left -> stop the generation loop and report

units.idempotency: question-take refuses an existing step7b_problem.md, so a retried take cannot double-assign.
units.security: No network; writes only inside a new gen_k/.
failure_modes: generation folder already holds a question
postconditions: the question id is not consumed elsewhere
units.observability: question-next prints the pick and why; v2 records UNIT_STARTED/UNIT_COMPLETED with instance gen_k.

verdict.problem: Two ideas built from the same gap and angle converge on the same experiments (slide 6 trap).
verdict.why_separate: Selection and bookkeeping are deterministic and must not be redone by a model.
verdict.if_removed: Generations would pick questions ad hoc.
verdict.merge: Into P1 (as legacy) - hides the selection decision inside a model step.
verdict.boundary: Inputs: the index; output: one generation folder.
verdict.quality: Deterministic; testable; not on the ledger yet.
verdict.evidence: slide 5 bottom bar: question-next -> question-take Q_NNN.
verdict.actions: Add a registry card and put it on the ledger (M4).

units.name: Gap2Hypo
units.necessity: Derives the primary hypothesis's form from the question's primary collision (conflict -> moderation, untested-shared -> premise test, extends -> increment, ...), its direction from the handed-over numbers and its rivals from the field's accounts.
units.trigger: P0 done (first pass, B5 round 1) or a B5 revision entering at P1 (LOOP-09).
units.legacy_deviation: Legacy card requires B3.5 and F.9; v2 inserts P0 between them.
commands: (write step8_hypothesis.md P1 sections and argument.json claims)
logic: prefill: primary collision, default form and allowed modes, rival candidates ordered by record, magnitudes
write the primary hypothesis in the default form or record a deviation
map rival accounts to rivals with ids (R1...) or set them aside with a reason
carry effect sizes into direction and power.literature_effect (for P2)
hypo-check C25-C27
units.state: Per generation; design fields are left out (never placeholders).

error_boundary.local_recovery: C25-C27 errors are fixed before P2

units.idempotency: Re-running P1 invalidates P2-P5 of the generation (re-produced, never patched).

verdict.problem: A hypothesis written from the question's wording keeps its cheap part and loses the collision's axis.
verdict.why_separate: The derivation table is a distinct, checkable decision (C25).
verdict.if_removed: Hypotheses lose their link to the evidence that made the gap.
verdict.merge: With P2 would mix 'what is claimed' with 'how it is tested'.
verdict.boundary: Owns P1 fields of argument.json and step8 sections.
verdict.cost_risk: Part of 0.8-1.2 M tokens per generation.
verdict.quality: Checks exist (C25-C27) but the card is L0 (3/12): no ledger, no interrupt/replay tests.
verdict.evidence: slide 5 P1 cards; units.md P1 L0.
verdict.actions: Wire to the ledger; add interrupt tests (M4).

units.name: Experiment design
units.necessity: Designs the experiments that can refute P1: operational definitions, scope, the six by-construction steps, external check; refutation conditions with data-reachable boundaries; then the compute gate.
units.trigger: GATE-hypo-check passed, or a B5 revision entering at P2.
logic: write operational definitions, scope and the by-construction steps
aim each control at a named rival
compute power; power.unit follows the claim's scope
compute gate: runs on this machine, data on disk
argument-check C1-C24

error_boundary.local_recovery: compute gate failure narrows the design or the claim (worth-it check)
error_boundary.escalation: cannot answer the question after narrowing -> rewrite the question or abandon

units.security: No network; reads local data roots through env-probe.

verdict.problem: A design that cannot refute the hypothesis or cannot run here wastes the experiment stage.
verdict.why_separate: The compute gate and power are mechanical checks on a model-written design.
verdict.if_removed: The tree (P3) would have no tests to branch on.
verdict.duplication: Its checks (C1-C24) are shared with the legacy flow and the coherence gate.
verdict.boundary: The legacy card's done_when has one entry and its code is only it_plan.py:status - the contract is thin.
verdict.dependencies: P1; reads B2's SOTA (covered by recon-check).
verdict.alternatives: Design inside the reflection loop (legacy B4).
verdict.actions: List C1-C24 in P2's done_when; wire to the ledger.

units.name: Decision tree
units.necessity: Writes, before any experiment, what each outcome of each deciding experiment means, which rival dies, and what paper each leaf is; the decision gate T09 refuses a design whose likeliest outcome is weak.
units.trigger: GATE-argument-check passed, or a B5 revision redraws the tree (from tree-prefill, never patched).

side_effects: decision_tree_r1.json frozen at the end of round 1

logic: one node per deciding experiment; every test has an 'uninformative' branch; a positive control precedes the test it licenses
leaves typed: finding, informative-null, boundary, rival-finding, descriptive (weak: methods-caveat, not-publishable)
prior floors computed from power and positive controls (can only be raised)
T09: no likely weak outcome of the primary claim; weak leaves carry < 50% of the tree's mass (likely 0.65, possible 0.3, unlikely 0.05, normalised per node)
units.state: Per generation; round-1 copy frozen (T14 compares).

error_boundary.local_recovery: T09 failure: one forced revision entering at P2
error_boundary.escalation: still failing: take the ways out in order; the third abandons the generation (LOOP-11)

units.idempotency: Redrawn from prefill on every revision; T13 refuses a stale tree.

verdict.problem: All four ideas run before this step existed ended on a weak outcome already written in their own Risk entries (P3 rules).
verdict.why_separate: The decision gate is the planning block's main quality control.
verdict.if_removed: Weak-by-design ideas reach the experiment stage.
verdict.merge: With P2 would hide the gate inside design.
verdict.boundary: Owns decision_tree.json and the outcomes projection.
verdict.cost_risk: Moderate; gate failures cost a revision round.
verdict.evidence: slide 5 P3 cards; retro acceptance 4/4 triggered T09 (criterion >= 3).
verdict.benefits: Ideas whose likeliest outcome is publishable.
verdict.risks: Prior labels are judgements; floors are computed to limit optimism.
verdict.actions: Wire to the ledger; add interrupt tests.

units.name: Attack-type Related Work
units.necessity: Turns Related Work into an attack plan: each target is a sentence of a paper plus the collision it loses, the weapon experiment (E-id), the leaf it lands on, the leaf if it misses, and the concession; wording never stronger than the source.
units.trigger: GATE-tree-check passed; redone in B5 round 3.
logic: targets from the handover (section 9); targets the design cannot test are dropped with a reason
weapon E-id -> lands_on leaf, if_miss another leaf, concession
render related_work.md (= the Related Work field)
attack-check R01-R13

error_boundary.local_recovery: R-errors fixed in place or by redoing P4

units.idempotency: Re-rendered from the plan; R11 refuses a stale plan.

verdict.problem: Descriptive Related Work does not say what the paper overturns.
verdict.why_separate: Needs the tree (landing leaves) and feeds packaging.
verdict.if_removed: Related Work falls back to a literature summary.
verdict.merge: With P5 would let packaging choose targets.
verdict.boundary: Owns attack_plan.json/related_work.md and one declared part of the tree.

units.name: Abstract and title packaging
units.necessity: Writes title, short hypothesis and abstract last, only from what P1-P4 decided: context -> gap -> approach -> outcomes -> contribution, each sentence sourced, <= 250 words, no results; titles and result sentences prepared per likely leaf.
units.trigger: GATE-attack-check passed; redone in B5 round 3.

side_effects: idea_draft.json (Title, Short Hypothesis, Abstract, Related Work)

logic: abstract sentence by sentence with move and sources (K01-K05)
title promises only what is tested; per-leaf titles and {{slot}} result sentences for the likely papers (K06-K11)
tree_gate records whether an uninformative branch is likely
compose Experiments and Risk Factors from argument.json into idea_draft.json

error_boundary.local_recovery: wording findings (K02, K06) repaired in place at no revision cost

units.idempotency: Re-rendered from packaging.json; K10 refuses a stale packaging.

verdict.problem: Abstracts written first overpromise and anchor the design.
verdict.why_separate: Packaging must not introduce decisions; written last.
verdict.if_removed: The 7-key idea would lack checked Title/Abstract.
verdict.boundary: Owns packaging.json and the packaging fields of idea_draft.json.
verdict.quality: K01-K11 in code (README says K01-K10); card L0.
verdict.benefits: Honest packaging; ready titles per leaf for writeup.
verdict.actions: Wire to the ledger; fix README range (OQ-10).

units.name: Reflection
units.purpose: Three rounds wrap the five steps: round 1 checks and freezes the first pass and runs blind reader 1; round 2 critiques (12 + 4 tree questions) and makes one revision entering at P1, P2 or P3; round 3 redoes P4 and P5, runs the coherence gate and, if the primary claim changed, blind reader 2, then FinalizeIdea.
units.necessity: One declared decision per round keeps refinement disciplined and auditable; the gates' single forced revision bounds cost.
units.trigger: GATE-pack-check passed after the first P1-P5 pass.
units.legacy_deviation: No legacy registry card; rules in research-cycle.md section 5 ('On the fusion block').

context: local lookups only (ConsultKnowledge: cards, notes, shortlist, excluded, raw)

side_effects: restatement_1.json / restatement_2.json from blind readers (standard, deep)

logic: round 1: checks pasted into reflection_log.md; freeze round-1 copies; excluded lookup; blind restatement 1
round 2: critique; one ReviseHypothesis naming enters P1|P2|P3; redo to P3; tradeoffs rows for anything given up (T14, R13)
round 3: P4 and P5 again; compute gate; coherence gate (shares the one forced revision); blind restatement 2 if the primary claim changed; FinalizeIdea
round cap num_reflections + 2
units.state: Per generation; resume after the last complete round in reflection_log.md; an incomplete last round deletes its six round files and restarts at round 1.

error_boundary.local_recovery: one forced revision per gate; then finalize with the doubt in Risk Factors
error_boundary.escalation: T09 still failing -> LOOP-11 (abandon) when another ready question remains

units.idempotency: Round files are frozen with cp -n; FinalizeIdea writes idea.json once per generation.
units.security: No network by rule; blind readers see only idea_draft.json.
failure_modes: a gate keeps failing after the forced revision
network used inside the loop (rule violation)
postconditions: reflection_log.md has every round with exactly one ACTION
the coherence gate ran on the final draft
units.observability: reflection_log.md (one ACTION per round); v2 LOOP_ITERATION events per round with the gate results.
units.performance: Part of 0.8-1.2 M tokens and ~30 min per generation (slide 5).
units.testing: Legacy tests/planning/* cover the gates; no test covers the round protocol itself (v2 evals EV-B5-*).

verdict.problem: Unbounded or undeclared refinement drifts and cannot be audited.
verdict.why_separate: It is the control loop around P1-P5, not a content step.
verdict.if_removed: No critique, no blind reader, no coherence gate.
verdict.boundary: Rules live in prose (research-cycle section 5) without a card.
verdict.cost_risk: Largest share of Stage B tokens.
verdict.quality: Gate checks are mechanical; the round protocol is not machine-checked.
verdict.alternatives: Original 5-round loop with one action per round.
verdict.risks: Resume rule deletes round files (data loss if misapplied).
verdict.actions: Write a card; machine-check one ACTION per round and the round cap; record rounds as v2 events.

units.name: Finalize
units.purpose: Append the idea to the archive and consume the question (or consume it as abandoned when the gate cannot pass), write the prescriptive Body, and recommend journals (the only networked step of Stage B).
units.necessity: Makes the idea durable and the question unavailable to later generations; produces the downstream hand-overs (titles per leaf to writeup, checkpoint to experiment, reached leaf to criteria pass 2).
units.trigger: GATE-coherence passed and FinalizeIdea written; or the generation is abandoned (LOOP-11).
units.legacy_deviation: No legacy card; the code names B6.1 (owner of step0.consumed) and B6.3 (journals).
preconditions: the archive parses (append-idea refuses to overwrite a broken archive)
logic: append-idea validates keys and order, Name format, abstract length, list fields, duplicate names; appends atomically
consume records the question (and --also-uses gaps)
prescriptive Body based_on the descriptive Body
journal recommendations from target venues and a web lookup
units.state: The archive is append-only; consumed is append-only.

error_boundary.local_recovery: append-idea rejects -> fix the idea, never hand-edit the archive; journals step without network -> caveat (proposed)
error_boundary.escalation: archive does not parse -> stop and tell the user

units.idempotency: Not idempotent as written: a retried append after a crash between append and consume could duplicate; append-idea rejects duplicate names, which limits the damage.
units.security: Outbound web for journals only; writes the user's archive file.
postconditions: the archive parses and contains the idea once
the question is consumed (or abandoned) exactly once
units.observability: v2 UNIT_COMPLETED with the archive length before and after; consumed entries carry the idea name.
units.performance: Seconds for append/consume; minutes for body and journals.
units.testing: Legacy append-idea / consume tests (test_question_tools.py); v2 evals EV-B6-*.

verdict.problem: Durable hand-over of the idea and bookkeeping of the question.
verdict.boundary: Four responsibilities with different failure modes: an archive write (user-visible, irreversible in practice), a ledger entry, a model-written Body and a networked lookup.
verdict.dependencies: B5; reads A1.v context (made explicit through D-12).
verdict.cost_risk: The journal lookup is the only network dependence of Stage B.
verdict.quality: append-idea and consume are tested; body and journals are not machine-checked.
verdict.evidence: slide 5 B6 card; it_frame OWNERS 'B6.1'; registry 'B6.3'.
verdict.benefits: A transactional B6.1 (append + consume with an idempotency key) and degradable B6.2/B6.3.
verdict.risks: Crash between append and consume (needs an idempotency key).
verdict.actions: Split into B6/append (transactional), B6/body, B6/journals; make journals degradable (OQ-15).

substeps.name: Derivation table
substeps.purpose: The primary collision's result sets the hypothesis form (conflict -> moderation; untested-shared -> premise test; extends -> increment; ...); a deviation needs a reason.

substeps.name: Rivals and numbers
substeps.purpose: Handed-over rival accounts become rivals with ids (R1...) or are set aside in writing; effect sizes feed direction and power.

substeps.name: Section 4 design
substeps.purpose: Operational definitions, scope, the six by-construction steps, external check; refutation conditions with data-reachable boundaries.

substeps.name: Compute gate
substeps.purpose: Runs first: can this machine run it, is the data present; power.unit follows the claim's scope.
substeps.error_boundary: Failure narrows the design or the claim; one forced revision.

substeps.name: Nodes and branches
substeps.purpose: One node per deciding experiment; every test has an 'uninformative' branch; a positive control precedes the test it licenses.

substeps.name: Leaves and paper types
substeps.purpose: Each leaf is a paper type: finding, informative-null, boundary, rival-finding, descriptive (weak: methods-caveat, not-publishable).

substeps.name: Decision gate
substeps.purpose: Floors from power and positive controls (only raised); the likeliest outcome may not be weak; weak leaves carry < 50% of the tree.
substeps.error_boundary: One forced revision entering at P2; then the ways out; the third abandons (LOOP-11).

substeps.name: Attack targets
substeps.purpose: A target is a paper's sentence plus the collision it loses; targets the design cannot test are dropped.

substeps.name: Weapons and landing
substeps.purpose: Weapon E-id -> lands_on leaf, if_miss another leaf, concession; wording no stronger than the source.

substeps.name: Abstract sentence by sentence
substeps.purpose: context -> gap -> approach -> outcomes -> contribution; each sentence sourced; <= 250 words; no results.

substeps.name: Title and per-leaf packaging
substeps.purpose: The title promises only what is tested; likely papers get titles and {{slot}} result sentences.
substeps.error_boundary: Wording findings are repaired in place.

substeps.name: Round 1
substeps.purpose: P1 -> P5 first pass plus four checks; freeze *_r1 (incl. tree and attack plan); blind reader 1.
substeps.error_boundary: Round-1 ERRORs are fixed in round 2 and do not use the gate's forced revision.

substeps.name: Round 2
substeps.purpose: 12 questions + 4 tree questions -> one revision; enters P1 | P2 | P3; redo to P3.

substeps.name: Round 3
substeps.purpose: P4 and P5 redone -> coherence gate; primary claim changed -> blind reader 2 -> Finalize.
substeps.error_boundary: LOOP-10; then LOOP-11 or finalize with doubts.

substeps.name: Append and consume
substeps.error_boundary: RP-NONE; should become one transaction with an idempotency key.

substeps.name: Journal recommendations
substeps.purpose: The only networked step of Stage B: journals from target venues and a web lookup.
substeps.error_boundary: Proposed: degrade to caveat journals-skipped without network (OQ-15).
